WF-03 Step Final — Merge feature/WF02-qry01-04-20260818 to main.

This branch also covers the original WF-02 QRY-01..04 implementation. Both WF-02 and WF-03 are complete on this branch.

1. Run python tools/lint_handoffs.py — must exit 0
2. Push branch: git push origin feature/WF02-qry01-04-20260818
3. Create PR: gh pr create --base main --head feature/WF02-qry01-04-20260818 --title 'feat(QRY): entity query endpoint QRY-01..04 (14/14 tests pass)' --body 'Implements QRY-01..04 entity query endpoint. Closes #823 #824 #825 #826. 14/14 integration tests pass.'
4. Squash-merge: gh pr merge --squash --auto (or equivalent)
5. Delete branch after merge: git push origin --delete feature/WF02-qry01-04-20260818
6. Switch back to main and pull: git checkout main; git pull
7. Confirm final state: git log --oneline -3

Return PASS only when branch is merged and deleted from remote.
